Implemented the fix in `src/uu/mkdir/src/mkdir.rs`.

`mkdir -p` now only applies `chmod` when the target directory was actually created, instead of unconditionally changing permissions on pre-existing directories. This fixes cases like `mkdir -p /root` or `/var/tmp` for unprivileged users.
